name: filemaker-pro-agent-skills
description: Modular FileMaker development skills for native calculations, scripts, BaseElements, MBS and bBox.

interface.longDescription: A modular reference set for Claris FileMaker developers. It covers native calculation functions, script steps, errors and APIs, plus the BaseElements, MBS and bBox plug-in dialects. An orchestrator routes each request to the owning skill and loads catalogs only when needed.
defaultPrompt: Review this FileMaker script and explain its errors and platform limits.
Look up a BaseElements function and show its parameters and compatibility.
Find the right MBS or bBox function for a FileMaker task.
